query:
UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'The world\'s most influential technology event. CES 2026 brings together 4,500+ exhibitors from 160+ countries showcasing breakthrough innovations in AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, smart home, and consumer electronics. The Robotics & Autonomous Systems section is one of the fastest-growing exhibit areas, featuring humanoid robots, industrial automation, and service robots from global manufacturers.',
  roboticsRelevance = 5,
  estimatedExhibitors = 4500,
  roboticsExhibitors = 320
WHERE name = 'CES 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'Manifest is the premier supply chain and logistics innovation conference, drawing 3,000+ supply chain leaders, technology providers, and investors. Robotics and automation are central themes, with dedicated tracks on warehouse robotics, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), last-mile delivery drones, and AI-driven logistics platforms.',
  roboticsRelevance = 5,
  estimatedExhibitors = 500,
  roboticsExhibitors = 120
WHERE name = 'Manifest 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'NAB Show is the world\'s largest media and entertainment technology event, attracting 90,000+ attendees from 160+ countries. Robotics applications in broadcast — including automated camera systems, robotic production equipment, AI-driven content creation tools, and autonomous broadcast infrastructure — are a growing segment of the exhibit floor.',
  roboticsRelevance = 3,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1700,
  roboticsExhibitors = 45
WHERE name = 'NAB Show 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'CONEXPO-CON/AGG is North America\'s largest construction industry trade show, held every three years. The 2026 edition features 2,400+ exhibitors across 2.5 million square feet of exhibits. Construction robotics, autonomous heavy equipment, exoskeletons for workers, and AI-powered site management systems are among the most anticipated exhibit categories.',
  roboticsRelevance = 4,
  estimatedExhibitors = 2400,
  roboticsExhibitors = 180
WHERE name = 'CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'HIMSS Global Health Conference is the world\'s most influential health information and technology event, drawing 40,000+ healthcare professionals. Medical robotics — including surgical robots, rehabilitation robots, autonomous pharmacy systems, and AI-assisted diagnostic tools — represent one of the most dynamic exhibit categories at HIMSS 2026.',
  roboticsRelevance = 4,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1200,
  roboticsExhibitors = 95
WHERE name = 'HIMSS 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'The SHOT Show is the world\'s premier trade show for the shooting sports, hunting, and outdoor industry. Defense and law enforcement robotics — including unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), surveillance drones, bomb disposal robots, and AI-powered security systems — are a growing presence at this invitation-only trade event.',
  roboticsRelevance = 3,
  estimatedExhibitors = 2800,
  roboticsExhibitors = 60
WHERE name = 'SHOT Show 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'PACK EXPO Las Vegas is the packaging and processing industry\'s most comprehensive event in the western United States, featuring 2,000+ exhibitors. Industrial robots for packaging lines, collaborative robots (cobots) for pick-and-place operations, vision-guided automation systems, and end-of-arm tooling are core exhibit categories.',
  roboticsRelevance = 5,
  estimatedExhibitors = 2000,
  roboticsExhibitors = 280
WHERE name = 'PACK EXPO Las Vegas 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'AWS re:Invent is Amazon Web Services\' annual cloud computing conference, attracting 60,000+ developers, architects, and technology leaders. Robotics sessions focus on AWS RoboMaker, robot simulation, cloud-connected autonomous systems, and AI/ML integration for robotic applications. A significant number of robotics startups use re:Invent to launch cloud-native robot platforms.',
  roboticsRelevance = 4,
  estimatedExhibitors = 800,
  roboticsExhibitors = 110
WHERE name = 'AWS re:Invent 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'The SEMA Show is the premier automotive specialty products trade event, drawing 160,000+ industry professionals and 2,400+ exhibitors. Automotive robotics — including robotic painting systems, autonomous vehicle platforms, EV battery assembly robots, and AI-powered vehicle diagnostics — are increasingly prominent exhibit categories at SEMA.',
  roboticsRelevance = 3,
  estimatedExhibitors = 2400,
  roboticsExhibitors = 55
WHERE name = 'SEMA Show 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'MJBizCon is the cannabis industry\'s largest trade show and conference, featuring 1,400+ exhibitors and 35,000+ attendees. Cannabis cultivation robotics — including automated trimming machines, robotic harvesting systems, precision dosing robots, and AI-driven cultivation management platforms — are among the fastest-growing exhibit segments.',
  roboticsRelevance = 2,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1400,
  roboticsExhibitors = 25
WHERE name = 'MJBizCon 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'ISC West is the largest security industry trade show in the United States, drawing 30,000+ security professionals and 1,000+ exhibitors. Security robotics — including autonomous patrol robots, AI-powered surveillance drones, access control robots, and integrated physical security automation platforms — are among the most rapidly expanding exhibit categories.',
  roboticsRelevance = 4,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1000,
  roboticsExhibitors = 85
WHERE name = 'ISC West 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'The International Roofing Expo is the roofing and exterior construction industry\'s premier event, featuring 400+ exhibitors and 12,000+ attendees. Construction robotics for roofing — including automated shingle installation systems, drone-based roof inspection platforms, and AI-powered project estimation tools — represent an emerging exhibit category.',
  roboticsRelevance = 2,
  estimatedExhibitors = 400,
  roboticsExhibitors = 15
WHERE name = 'International Roofing Expo 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'LIGHTFAIR International is the world\'s largest annual architectural and commercial lighting trade show and conference, featuring 500+ exhibitors. Smart lighting robotics — including automated lighting installation drones, AI-driven lighting control systems, and robotic luminaire positioning systems — represent an emerging exhibit category at LIGHTFAIR 2026.',
  roboticsRelevance = 2,
  estimatedExhibitors = 500,
  roboticsExhibitors = 20
WHERE name = 'LIGHTFAIR International 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'The International Pizza Expo is the world\'s largest pizza industry trade show, featuring 1,000+ exhibitors and 14,000+ attendees. Food service robotics — including automated pizza-making robots, AI-driven dough preparation systems, robotic delivery platforms, and smart kitchen automation — are a growing presence in the food technology exhibit sections.',
  roboticsRelevance = 2,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1000,
  roboticsExhibitors = 18
WHERE name = 'International Pizza Expo 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';

UPDATE trade_shows SET
  description = 'MAGIC Las Vegas is one of the fashion industry\'s most iconic trade events, featuring 1,800+ brands and 60,000+ attendees. Fashion technology robotics — including automated garment manufacturing systems, AI-powered inventory robots, robotic retail fulfillment platforms, and smart fitting room technology — represent an emerging exhibit category.',
  roboticsRelevance = 1,
  estimatedExhibitors = 1800,
  roboticsExhibitors = 10
WHERE name = 'MAGIC Las Vegas 2026' AND city = 'Las Vegas';
